dead.label: Nothing uses them
dead.what: Not exported, and no call, reference or template mention the scan can see: likely dead.
dead.empty: Every function that is not exported is used.

unreferenced.label: Exported, unused here
unreferenced.what: Exported, but nothing in the scan uses them: dead, or used from outside (a tool or script).
unreferenced.empty: Every export is used somewhere in the scan.

export.label: Used only in their file
export.what: Exported, but used only in the file that exports them: the export can go.
export.empty: No export is used only in its own file.

hint: A hint, not a verdict. Left out: tests, methods, default exports, framework-loaded files and entry exports.
working: Working out the calls and uses…
never: No other file ever mentioned it.
lastTitle: The last commit where another file mentioned {name}
whenHelp: Roughly when its last use went: the last commit where another file mentioned it
